title: AutoGym: Blueprint-First Generation of Verifiable Agent Gyms
abstract: arXiv:2609.22592v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training agents with reinforcement learning requires a gym, comprising a task, an executable environment in which the task can be attempted, and a verifier that reliably distinguishes success from failure. Constructing such gyms remains manual, expensive, and static. Task sets saturate as models improve and are increasingly exposed to contamination. Synthetic generation offers scale, but single-pass synthesis produces tasks whose difficulty is largely cosmetic. Models comparable in capability solve them despite convoluted phrasing, and correctness must be adjudicated post-hoc by unreliable LLM judges. We present AutoGym, a framework that generates complete gyms (tasks, executable environments, and verifiers) from a minimal domain seed or prior model trajectories. translated_title: AutoGym：以蓝图优先方式生成可验证的智能体训练场
translated_abstract: 使用强化学习训练智能体需要一个训练场，其中包含任务、一个可以尝试执行任务的可执行环境，以及一个能够可靠区分成功与失败的验证器。构建这样的训练场目前仍然依赖人工、成本高昂且静态不变。随着模型能力提升，任务集会趋于饱和，并且越来越容易受到数据污染的影响。合成生成虽然提供了规模化能力，但单次合成产生的任务其难度大多只是表面上的：能力相当的模型即使面对晦涩的措辞也能解决这些任务，而其正确性必须事后由不可靠的大语言模型裁判来判定。我们提出AutoGym，一个能够从最小领域种子或已有模型轨迹生成完整训练场（任务、可执行环境和验证器）的框架。AutoGym引入了三种机制：(1) 蓝图优先生成，在构建环境之前先规定有效解空间、环境需求和验证标准……
tldr: AutoGym提出蓝图优先的生成框架，可从最小领域种子或模型轨迹自动生成包含任务、可执行环境和验证器的完整可验证智能体训练场，解决了人工构建成本高、任务易饱和与污染、以及合成任务难度流于表面的问题。
en_tdlr: AutoGym is a blueprint-first framework that automatically generates complete verifiable agent gyms—tasks, executable environments, and verifiers—from minimal domain seeds or prior model trajectories, addressing the high manual cost, saturation and contamination of task sets, and the superficial difficulty of single-pass synthetic tasks.
